author: Crowgin
quote:
I’m sorry this game is dogwater. In the first 5-6 hours you’re literally catering to your GF to fix the house repair the roof buy flowers ? Some ppl will say it’s optional which TECH this BUT with dire consequences. No spoiler But trust me it’s a joke .PS5pro drops at times to 16FPS, littered with bugs and endless game breaking glitches . Poor written characters , can’t do nearly as much as the previous GTAs. ( Can’t steal half the cars in the game ) 
No real way to get rid of Lucia she’s the most demanding self centered all about her and bossing Jason around constantly. I mean let’s face it , this is a far cry from anything remotely close to what GTA is. Stay away from this dogwater. Not with it .  3/10!
